bmt-2015-analysis-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_k$ be real numbers for some natural number $k$. Find $$\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(\frac{(a_1)^n+(a_2)^n+\dots+(a_k)^n}{k}\right)^{1/n}.$$
bmt-2015-analysis-tiebreaker-03.reviewNote: As printed (real a_i, all n) the limit need not exist, e.g. a_1=-2, k=1; the answer given is the intended max|a_i| (valid for non-negative a_i or even n). No official key available.
